focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需紧急核查CBAM数据合规
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧委会发布过渡期数据质量评估报告，指出部分第三国申报数据存在缺漏。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业须在剩余一个半月内完成2026年第四季度排放数据申报，并确保上游供应商数据可追溯。建议企业立即启动CBAM合规审计，对无法提供实际排放数据的供应商采用默认值将显著增加成本，并可能引发后续核查风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM过渡期报告 · 2026.11.16
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Emissions Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime and levy starting in 2027. The European Commission's recent data quality assessment flagged gaps in declarations from some third countries. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers must file Q4 2026 emissions data within the remaining six weeks and ensure upstream supplier data is traceable. Companies should immediately launch CBAM compliance audits; relying on default values where actual data is unavailable will significantly raise costs and may trigger future verification risks.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM Transitional Period Report · 2026.11.16

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境电子证据采信标准，中资企业应完善数据留存与公证链条
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一宗涉华贸易合同纠纷中，明确了对境外电子证据的采信规则：主张电子证据的一方须证明数据生成系统的可靠性及保管链条完整性，仅提供截图或未经公证的邮件打印件不足以采信。该案中，中方企业因未能提供服务器日志及公证文书而败诉。此案提示中国出海企业，在跨境交易中应约定电子证据的留存与公证方式，优先使用可信时间戳或区块链存证，并确保争议发生时能快速调取原始数据。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判例摘要 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Sets Standard for Cross-Border Electronic Evidence; Chinese Firms Need Robust Data Retention and Notarisation
case.summary_en: In a recent trade contract dispute involving Chinese parties, the Singapore Court of Appeal clarified the admissibility of foreign electronic evidence: the party relying on it must prove the reliability of the data-generating system and the integrity of the chain of custody. Screenshots or un-notarised email printouts are insufficient. The Chinese company lost the case for failing to produce server logs and notarised records. This ruling underscores the need for Chinese outbound enterprises to agree on e-evidence retention and notarisation methods, use trusted timestamps or blockchain storage, and ensure original data can be retrieved swiftly in disputes.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal Case Summary · 2026.10

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，涉外企业需调整数据出境合规路径
policy.summary: 广东省近期发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，进一步扩大科研、金融、医疗等领域的数据跨境试点，并简化安全评估流程。新规允许符合条件的企业通过“数据跨境安全网关”进行申报，缩短审批时间。但对于涉及重要数据或超过一定数量的个人信息出境，仍须进行安全评估。建议大湾区涉外企业重新梳理数据资产，区分一般数据与重要数据，利用试点政策优化出境路径，同时完善与境外接收方的数据保护协议。
policy.source: 来源：广东省网信办政策解读 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: New GBA Cross-Border Data Flow Rules Take Effect; Foreign-Related Firms Must Adjust Data Export Compliance
policy.summary_en: Guangdong province has issued new facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area (GBA), expanding pilot schemes in research, finance, and healthcare and simplifying security assessment procedures. Eligible companies can file through a 'cross-border data security gateway' with shorter approval times. However, exports involving important data or personal information exceeding certain thresholds still require security assessment. GBA foreign-related enterprises should re-map data assets, distinguish ordinary from important data, leverage pilot policies to optimise export routes, and strengthen data protection agreements with overseas recipients.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Cyberspace Administration Policy Interpretation · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企需重构跨境投资架构与退出机制
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期拟进一步扩大对外投资审查范围，将更多涉及人工智能、量子计算等敏感技术的对外投资纳入申报。中国企业在美投资或与美国基金共同投资时，应提前评估交易是否触发申报义务，避免因未申报导致交易被强制撤销或处罚。建议在投资协议中设置“监管审批”先决条件及分手费条款，并考虑通过第三地架构分散风险。同时，应建立投资后合规监控机制，对技术出口和人员往来实施动态筛查。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队实务观察 · 2026.11.16
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Deals and Exit Mechanisms
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US is poised to further expand outbound investment screening to cover more sensitive technologies such as AI and quantum computing. Chinese companies investing in the US or co-investing with US funds should assess whether transactions trigger filing obligations in advance to avoid forced divestment or penalties for non-compliance. We recommend including regulatory approval conditions and break fees in investment agreements, and considering third-country structures to mitigate risks. Post-investment compliance monitoring, including dynamic screening of technology exports and personnel exchanges, should also be established.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao's Practice Observations · 2026.11.16
